notes.content:
Most of v1.1 changes/fixes were pushed to v1.0.2.0 because of critical bug
Changes:

Fixed player's thirdperson model normal texture

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2.0
notes.content:
Changes:

Added in-game tip show/hide sounds
Fixed occluder in level 18
Fixed level 33 mesh disappearing on some devices
Fixed level 49
Improved shader preparation process
Improved Rigid Body - Water interactions
Improved death/jumpscare FX
Improved level 29 FX
Improved level 75 loading time
Reduced stutters caused by jumpscares
Reduced unique stutters in a few levels
Filesize reduction
Optimization
Other minor changes
Other small bugfixes
